_comment: Which identity and contact values this exact PDF must show. Copy into the ResumeVersion directory as identity-contract.json, keep only the fact IDs this artifact actually carries, then set confirmation_basis to human_confirmed. Without this file the audit reports no_contract and judges nothing: a resume legitimately omits a former employer, a second degree or an address it never claimed to show, and a check that judged every fact in the profile would call ordinary selection a defect.
artifact_sha256: <sha256 of the exact resume file this contract governs>
candidate_profile_sha256: <the version's candidate_profile_sha256, not whichever snapshot is active now>
